question: Does the unchanged development-passing prompt meet the approved mask-fidelity standard on reserved note-subject inputs that did not inform prompt development?
candidate_mechanism: Removal conditioned on the fixed subject should exclude additional meanings while retaining required identifying evidence. Final validation measures remaining errors; it does not isolate causality.
selection: ../../final-reservation.json, support-audit each batch before any masks. Preserve unsupported subjects and hash-ordered replacements, if any.
next_batches: Review each batch before admission of the next. Begin with three notes; expand to at most four notes per reviewed first-call batch if results support it. Repeats are added only for the six already predesignated reserved subjects.
repeat_rule: No same demonstrated semantic error in two of three trials for any of the six predesignated repeated subjects.
stop_rule: Stop if three nonaccepted outputs make 50/52 mathematically impossible, or if the repeatability rule is violated. Preserve all attempted outputs; no retry-to-pass.
unchanged: ASv6.23, full original source, one .subject per call, no auxiliary context, exact substring array output, fresh isolated Astra-low call, tools/web disabled, existing subscription and guarded concurrent runner.
decision: Only freeze after all52 outputs meet gates and verification is complete. If failures inform a prompt revision, retire this final set to development; no partial pass.
uncertainty: Finite coverage and semantic-review judgments; no population guarantee and no SSE/segmentation conclusion.
